description: Bitcoin mainnet JSON-RPC from Bitcoin Core: getblockchaininfo, getrawtransaction, sendrawtransaction and the rest of the node RPC.

rpc_types.backend_hint: bitcoind RPC, default :8332 (basic auth or cookie)

serving.backend: Bitcoin Core full node with server=1, txindex=1 for getrawtransaction on arbitrary txids, and rpcallowip for the RelayMiner.
serving.notes: bitcoind requires RPC auth; the RelayMiner backend_url must carry the credentials. Two suppliers today. No gateway health check configured yet.
